answer: In this PoA model, reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life, so influence must be replenished through sustained, honestly verified service rather than a brief burst. EigenTrust factorization and reciprocity-weighted transitivity assign freshly spawned Sybil identities near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted incoming edges; collusion cannot bootstrap consensus. A lagoon, raven, or voyage-themed identity remains powerless until legitimate peers gradually reciprocate trust.
